mod23_unit7_availability_B5_proxy_2011_2.classification_evidence: No positive control and no admissible closing ground; season-blocked bootstrap interval reported.
mod23_unit7_availability_B5_proxy_2011_2.description: Base model with rolling team inputs adjusted for own QB snap share in each past game, paired vs base, 2011-2019; 1145-1086 vs 1142-1089.
mod23_unit7_availability_B5_proxy_2011_2.notes: B5 adds a top-2 RB absence group to unit 6b B3; two eras (two new looks, family total 21); snap counts of completed games; coefficients fit on earlier seasons only.
mod23_unit7_availability_B5_proxy_2011_2.plain_summary: Also discounting past games by running-back absence gave a small unresolved change in picks against the opener.
